content: Gibxe Biittan Isra7eele Nayta Bolla Gakkida Naaqonne Qoho
Baso asa ubbaa ekki Yaaqoobera Gibxe bida Yaaqoobe nayta sunththi hayssafe kaalli xaafettides.
Isttika Oroobeele, Simoona, Lewe, Yuhuda,
Yisakoore, Zaabiloone, Biniyaame,
Daane, Niftaaleme, Gaadenne Aaseere.
Yaaqoobe zereththati mulera laappun tamma; Yooseefey kasetidi Gibxe biidi heen dees.
Yooseefey, iza ishatinne he yeletay wurikka hayqqides;
gido attiin Isra7eele zereththati yelettidi keehi darida; he biittaa kumana gakkanaas istti keehi corattida.
Hessafe guye Yooseefe erontta ooraththa kawoy Gibxe biittan dendides.
Izi ba asaa, «Be7ite; hayti Isra7eele asay nuuppe keehi daridanne wolqqamida.
Haa yiite, ane nuni istta hiillan oykkoos; histtontta aggiko istti kaseppe gede dari dari baana. Geelli gida olay dendiko istti nu morkketara gaaggidi nuna olananne biittaa yeggidi baana» gides.
Hessa gishshas deexo ooson istta tuggasana mala istta bolla halaqata doorida. Isttika kawos Piitoomenne Eraamise geetettiza dumma dumma minjja miishshata woththiza katamata keexxida.
Gido attiin Gibxe asay istta keehi waayisida wode istti gujetti gujetti yelettidanne biitta gakkida. Hessa gishshas Gibxe asay Isra7eele nayta ixxides.
Hessa gishshas istta daro daabursiza ooson waayisida.
Wolqqama ooson, simintoninne xuube medhon, qasse goshshe goyson, istta duussan un7eththida; daabursiza ooso ubbaa qadhetay baynda istta oosisida.
Gibxe kawoy Ibraawe maccassata yelissiza Sipooronne Puuho geetettiza nam7u maccassatas,
«Ibraawe maccassati yeliza wode intte yelissishin yelettidayssi attuma naa gidikko wodhite; gido attiin macca naa gidikko wodhopite»
Gido attiin Yelissizayti Xoossas babbidi Gibxe kawoy istta azazida mala ooththibeettenna; wodhontta attuma nayta paxa aggida.
Hessafe guye Gibxe kawoy he yelissizayta xeygidi, «Intte ays hayssaththo ooththidetii? Attuma nayta ays paxa aggidetii?» gi oychchides.
Yelissizayti zaaridi, «Ibraawe maccassati Gibxe maccassata mala gidettenna; istti mino gidida gishshas yelissizayti gakkanaappe sinththatidi yelichcheettes» gida.
Hessa gishshas Xoossi yelissizaytas kiyides. Asaa qoodaykka gujetti gujetti biidi kaseyssafe gede daridesinne minnides.
Qasse yelissizayti Xoossas babbida gishshas Xoossi isttas yelo immi anjjides.
Hessafe guye kawoy ba asaa ubbaa, «Ibraawetappe yelettiza adde naa ubbaa Nayle geetettiza Shaafa haaththan olite; gido attiin macca nay yelettiko paxa aggite» giidi azazides.

footnotes.text: Laappun tamma (Medhe 46:26-27) gizayssa hayqo abban beettida maxaafaninne laappun tammu eranchchata birsheththan, «Laappun tammanne ichchasha» gees. (Hawa 7:14 be7a)
